task_context: Move agent construction + the drain/error loop onto the shared build_agent_invocation/drive_invocation path, rewiring first the executor and then dispatch_task onto it (plus a docstring fix and a SubagentSuspended re-export).

expected_findings.description: cross-cutting gap completed by the dispatch_task rewire: task 0 pinned the executor's ceiling-resolution contract (agent.max_tool_calls -> workflow.defaults.max_tool_calls -> None). The second caller of build_agent_invocation passes max_tool_calls=subagent_def.max_tool_calls, dropping the workflow-defaults tier, so a subagent that declares no ceiling runs UNCAPPED while the executor caps the same workflow. The diverging tier lives in task 3 but is only a bug RELATIVE to the contract task 0 established; a per-task review of either commit alone sees a self-consistent change and misses the contract divergence. A completeness pass comparing both callers of the shared builder catches it.

+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import pytest

+
+def test_raise_if_suspended_reraises_only_suspended() -> None:
+    from imp.agents.subagents import SubagentSuspended, raise_if_suspended
+
+    # Non-suspend exceptions are a no-op (caller falls through to is_error).
+    raise_if_suspended(ValueError("x"))
+    with pytest.raises(SubagentSuspended):
+        raise_if_suspended(SubagentSuspended("paused"))
+
+
+def test_subagent_suspended_is_reexported_from_agent_run() -> None:
+    from imp.agents.subagents import SubagentSuspended as A
+    from imp.engine.agent_run import SubagentSuspended as B
+    assert A is B  # re-export, not a second class

+from __future__ import annotations

+
+@pytest.mark.anyio
+async def test_nesting_threads_depth_and_child_subagents(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
+    """A child that declares a grandchild gets depth+1 and the grandchild in its
+    own subagent_defs (so it COULD dispatch it). Enables+threads nesting."""
+    capture: dict = {}
+    ctx = _ctx(tmp_path, depth=0)
+    ctx.subagent_defs = {
+        "child": _agent("child", subagents=("grandchild",)),
+        "grandchild": _agent("grandchild"),
+    }

+    async def _spawn(_inv):

+            capture=capture)

+    assert "grandchild" in inv.subagent_defs
+
+
+@pytest.mark.anyio
+async def test_nesting_past_max_depth_raises_to_parent(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
+    ctx = _ctx(tmp_path, depth=MAX_SUBAGENT_DEPTH)  # child would be MAX+1
+    ctx.subagent_defs = {"child": _agent("child")}
+
+    async def _spawn(_inv):
+        return _FakeRunner([{"type": "agent_output", "payload": {"status": "Success"}}])
+
+    ctx.spawn_subagent = _spawn
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="exceeds MAX_SUBAGENT_DEPTH"):
+        await dispatch_task(ctx, "child", "too deep")
